notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Magda.
description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Honor-Worn Shaku ability, untapping it.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat.
